senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; קָוַץ)heat, midsummer, harvest time for figs, grapes &c., contrad. to קציר harvest time for grains.
units: B. Mets. 106ᵇ (ref. to Gen. VIII, 22 חצי ניסן … אב ק׳ וכ׳ half of Nisan, the whole of Iyar, and half of Sivan is ḳatsir (cutting season), half of Sivan to half of Ab is ḳayits (midsummer) &c.; Gen. R. s. 34.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15">Ex. R. s. 15</cite> <he>עשיר … בשעת הק׳</he> a rich man who went out at harvest time (when grapes were cut).

<cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 8:4">Ned. VIII, 4</cite> <he>עד הק׳ עד שיהא הק׳ וכ׳</he> if one vows abstinence ‘until harvest time’, it means until harvest begins, until people begin to bring fruits home in baskets (v. <cite ref="K00757"><he>כַּלְכָּלָה</he></cite>); <he>עד שיעבור הק׳ וכ׳</he> ‘until harvest is past’, it means &c., v. <cite ref="M02441"><he>מַקְצוּעָה</he></cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 3:1">B. Bath. III, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Batra 28a">28ᵃ</cite>) <he>כנס</he> (<he>קֵיצוֹ</he>) <he>את קַיְיצוֹ</he> after storing up his fruits.

Tosef. Ned. IV, 1 הנודר מן הק׳ אין אסור וכ׳ if one vows abstinence from ḳayits, he is forbidden figs only; ib. 2 (anoth. opin.) ענבים בכלל ק׳ grapes are included in ḳayits; Ned. 61ᵇ מפירות הק׳ from the fruits of midsummer; (ib. ענבים בכלל תאנים). Y. ib. VIII, 41ᵃ top ביכר ק׳ בעמקים if the first summer fruits are ripe in the valleys; (Bab. ib. 62ᵇ; Tosef. ib. IV, 7 הגיע הק׳ the harvest has begun).

Naz. 8ᵇ כהילקטי ק׳, v. הֶילְקֵט; Tosef. ib. I, 3; Y. ib. I, 51ᵇ bot. (not כמלקטי); a. e.—Trnsf. ק׳ המזבח the altar’s summer time, a time when the altar was unemployed for private offerings, and free-will burnt-offerings had to be supplied from the Temple fund.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 4:4">Shek. IV, 4</cite> <he>מותר הפירות לק׳ המ׳</he> the net income from the sale of fruits (of the Sabbatical year) was applied to the purchase of sacrifices for the altar’s summer time; Y. ib. 48ᵇ top (not <he>למזבח</he>).
<cite ref="Tosefta Menahot 10:8">Tosef. Men. X, 8</cite>, v. <cite ref="S00530"><he>קוּץ</he> II</cite>.
